name: OpenZoid Legacy
author: DaviFX
description: OpenZoid effects ported to Zoidium's deterministic render path: Echo (Legacy) and Posterize Time (Legacy) on the core temporal APIs, Jpeg Damage, VHS and Datamosh, Tracery tracking callouts and ASCII character cells, with floating setup windows.

nativeEffects.name: Echo (Legacy)
nativeEffects.description: Smear, maximum, additive and screen echoes of earlier frames, sampled through the core frame sampler (up to 16 echoes).

nativeEffects.name: Posterize Time (Legacy)
nativeEffects.description: Frame-rate quantizer in the Posterize Time style, applied as a deterministic core time operator.

nativeEffects.name: Jpeg Damage
nativeEffects.description: JPEG compression-break simulation with frequency and error controls, driven by clip-local time with an optional offset.

nativeEffects.name: VHS
nativeEffects.description: Signal-chain rebuild: tape, noise, tracking and chroma distortions, plus persistence averaged from sampled clip frames or the composite below an Adjustment layer. Setup window included.

nativeEffects.name: Datamosh
nativeEffects.description: Deterministic datamosh: keyframe-interval segments with motion warped from a bounded set of sampled source frames. Setup window included.

nativeEffects.name: Tracery
nativeEffects.description: Tracking callouts: boxes, markers, spline connection lines, arrows, labels, grid and key detection.

nativeEffects.name: ASCII
nativeEffects.description: Character-cell video: resampled glyph grid with band mapping, color modes, waves, noise, and scroll.
